external.title: GS Control satellite events
external.introduction: This optional service provides centrally collected and approved satellite activity announcements. Enabling it applies to every user of this Ground Station installation.
external.connection: After acceptance, the backend registers a shared installation ID with reports.gscontrol.net and downloads from events.gscontrol.net. The services receive this ID and authentication credential, the deployment environment, public IP address and requested date range. Event request details, including IP addresses, are retained for 7 days; the latest contact and approximate country inferred locally from its IP are retained for 60 days; aggregates without installation IDs or IPs are retained for up to one year. The same ID links event use with hardware census participation when separately enabled. No account details, station coordinates or local observations are sent.
external.cache: The backend downloads events immediately and every six hours, storing a local cache for the previous 30 days and next 180 days. Withdrawals appear after the next successful synchronization. Disabling the service stops downloads and clears this cache.
external.terms: Announcements are provided for information and may change or contain uncertain timing. Check the linked sources before relying on them. They do not automatically schedule observations. During an outage, previously cached announcements remain visible with a synchronization warning.
external.accept: I accept these terms and enable this service for all users of this station.
